name: SM_Stair_Flight_R_PR

textures.channels: tangent normal, OpenGL (green up; flip green on import)
R occlusion, G roughness, B metallic

material_exception: unique BC/N/ORM bake private to this asset: the joinery needs its own ambient occlusion and wear
pivot: base centre (bbox centre in X/Y, mesh bottom at z = 0), front on -Y
dresses: as Stair_Flight_L, going up to the right
known_weaknesses: The flight ends at 3.5 m without a landing or a trimmed ceiling opening: in the room it runs into the ceiling. One convex hull would close the space under it, so no collision is exported. Boards are bevelled blocks butted together: no joints, pegs or nails are modelled, and the grain is procedural streaking, not a scan. Every board is 12 triangles in the game mesh, so edge rounding is in the normal map only.
source_note: the .blend holds the game mesh with its baked set; the dense boards it was baked from are rebuilt by the script (they were removed after the bake to keep the file small)
